heading: About Us
introduction: Nor’easters Track Club brings together competitive women runners ages 35 and up from New England.
description:
Nor’easters is a competitive masters women’s team (35+)  based in the greater Boston and Providence area. We’re a supportive, high-performing group focused on everything from 400m track events to the marathon. We differ from other local clubs in that we don't focus on the USATF-NE Grand Prix circuit; instead, we select a small number of priority races each year that we race as a team. Our athletes are passionate about competing at a high level while balancing careers, families, and busy lives outside of running. Though we train individually, we race together regularly, from track meets to road races in distances up to the half marathon, and love the camaraderie that comes with competing as a team.

Beyond racing, we're dedicated to helping women discover (or rediscover!) the joy of running, the confidence that comes from challenging themselves, and the friendships that make the sport so special. We’re building a running community for young masters women with little free time who want to connect and share their love of the sport.  We're dedicated to proving that women in their 30s, 40s, and beyond can keep racing and can keep enjoying the sport together.
